messages:
ana.fernandez: hi everyone, super excited to start! quick hiccup: the Okta invite landed in my gmail alias (ana+redwood@gmail.com) and when i try to accept it says 'account already exists'. not sure what to do next. cc @rachel-people-ops

jess-it: welcome ana! that error usually means an existing Google identity conflicts with our provisioning. can you paste the exact Okta error or screenshot? also, are you planning to use a company-managed device or personal laptop?

ana.fernandez: exact text is: "This email is already associated with an existing account. Contact your admin.". i'm on a personal macbook, but can also use my phone if needed.

rachel-people-ops: hey ana, welcome! we can fix this. two options: 1) people-ops requests an alternate email to be added as a secondary address on your org profile, or 2) we can reprovision using your gmail address as a guest if jess approves. jess?

jess-it: option 2 is simpler for speed — create a guest Okta account tied to ana+redwood@gmail.com. i'll relax some device trust checks for initial enrollment. rachel, can you confirm acceptance of guest accounts?

rachel-people-ops: confirmed. i've updated the onboarding ticket with consent. go ahead.

okta-bot: automated message 2024-11-10T14:05:12Z New Okta guest invite created for ana+redwood@gmail.com by jess-it

jess-it: invite sent. heads up: if you plan to enroll a passkey on Safari, we sometimes see the browser prompt fail if iCloud Keychain isn't enabled. if you hit that, switch to Chrome or enroll a TOTP app as fallback.

(5m later)

ana.fernandez: accepted the invite but passkey enrollment fails on my mac: safari shows the spinning prompt and then "Could not create a passkey". tried toggling iCloud Keychain, still no luck.

alan-eng: hey ana, i've seen that. quick workaround: open chrome and try again, or use the Authy/Google Authenticator 2FA option for now. we can migrate passkey later.

jess-it: temporarily relaxed device policy for that guest account for 20 minutes. try chrome and if it still fails, enroll TOTP: Settings -> Security -> Set up authenticator app.

ana.fernandez: switched to chrome, passkey setup completed! thanks. i also don't see access to the engineering sprint board (jira) or the repo.

jess-it: adding you to eng-oncall and repo access now. repo group sync may take 2-3 minutes. you should get a 1password invite shortly too.

1password-bot: automated message 2024-11-10T14:12:07Z 1Password invite sent to ana+redwood@gmail.com by rachel-people-ops

ana.fernandez: got the 1password invite, but the vaults I can see are only the public ones. will i get access to service credentials?

rachel-people-ops: contractors and guests start with limited vault access. if you need secrets for onboarding, reply here with the specific vault or secret name and we'll create a temporary share. what do you need?

ana.fernandez: need the deploy key for staging and a test DB connection string to run local tests.

rachel-people-ops: noted. created a temporary share valid for 72h and added an onboarding note. check your 1password shared items.

ana.fernandez: can clone repo now and the staging creds work. all good. thanks everyone! :tada:

alan-eng: welcome! ping me if you want a quick walkthrough of the dev environment. we usually pair on first PRs.

jess-it: closing device trust relax. if you have any SSO/device prompts later, try an incognito window or reach out. :rocket:
